content:
Recovery plan failed validation due to missing or incorrectly formatted 'Actions:' fields in the scenario summaries.
The verifier returned a reward of 0.00 because test_summary_structure_and_required_statements failed with an AssertionError. Specifically, Scenario 1 was flagged for missing the required field 'Actions:', despite the text appearing to contain it. This suggests a regex mismatch in re.search(rf'^\s*{re.escape(label)}', section) likely caused by unexpected leading characters or newline handling in the summary_text structure.
